errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis is marked at 4-year intervals, but the chart shows tick marks for every 2 years (e.g., 1946, 1948, 1950).
The description claims that the solid blue line has circular markers, but there are no markers on the line in the chart.
The description states the peak value of ~65 occurred in 1954. However, the chart shows the peak value (~66) occurred in 1952. In 1954, the value was much lower, around 14.
The description states the value in 1970 is approximately 25, but the chart shows the value is approximately 40.
The description states the value in 1980 is approximately 10, but the chart shows the value is close to 0.
The description of the dotted line claims it has a 'smooth downward trend' from the start. However, the line first rises to a peak around 1952-1954 before it begins to decline.
The description states that the value of the dotted line in 1974 is approximately 5, but the chart shows it is closer to 10.
